verdicts.reason: In A, a leftover dark header slab sits behind half of the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow, which is a clear collision. The SOLSTICE wordmark has lost its dark field and is barely visible as white on cream, and the headline, divider, body copy, CTA and legal text are crammed into one tight centre column with almost no gaps. B keeps the logo intact on its dark panel and gives the headline clear dominance with a left-to-right banner flow. Its flaws: the eyebrow and divider sit under the logo panel, cut off from the headline; the right column (body copy, CTA and illegibly small legal text) is cramped against the right edge; and the left/right weighting is uneven.
